title: Cancel
description: From Core (or from an operator interface to Core, which checks it and passes it on): stop a command. With task_id, cancel that Task: a queued one is dropped; an active one stops. Without task_id, stop whatever motion is running now. After stopping, the Asset holds (hovers in place, or stays on the ground) and sets run_state paused, so it does not start the next Task until resumed. It reports report.status task cancelled for a Task, and report.settings (run_state paused, reply_to this seq).
